The datasheet describes one **100GbE / 100GBASE DWDM QSFP28** design: host electrical **CAUI-4** (4×25 Gbps **NRZ**), line **103.12 Gbps** with **PAM4** on two ~56.25 Gbps optical lanes, **ITU-T G.694.1** grid. Ordering table splits only by **model** (center channel). There are no separate amplified vs unamplified parameter sets in the pool, and no penalties were supplied. **CAUI-4** is used for `host_interface_name` (electrical host interface); **QSFP28** is the module MSA.
